contractChanges.SDK-006: Inbound filters apply before every accepted category: Origin/Referer allowed domains on every request; trusted IP, crawler, legacy-browser and localhost checks also on Sentry feedback and client reports; error-only rules stay on errors. Counters match the transport requests and items unmodified Sentry browser and Node SDKs send, including automatic client reports; unavailable category fields are named. The owner acts as maintainer until TEAM-001.
contractChanges.GROUP-001: Native JavaScript, Python and Go events take versioned stack and fingerprint rules with a no-write preview, immutable versions and per-event explanations; library frames collapse in the event view; selected occurrences can be split or merged with preview, audit, kept original membership and undo. Saving rules never moves existing occurrences.
contractChanges.SDK-011: Partial: deflate intake beside gzip, counted 415 for unsupported encodings, and malformed event items isolated as invalid_item while valid companion errors are admitted.
contractChanges.MIG-001: On an installation RER provisions for an approved Business plan (RER_IMPORT_DOOR=on with owner-claim trust bindings), the owner's first claim opens the Business import door; a door the owner turns off stays off. Self-hosted rer deploy never sets RER_IMPORT_DOOR. The door also accepts RER's Business export namespace sentry.

agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.4.0: export a private archive first (Settings > Download private archive, or rer export --output exports/spool.rer with local dev stopped). In a checkout of main run git pull; in a checkout of an earlier tag run git fetch --tags && git checkout v0.5.0. Then rer dev locally, or rer deploy from the original deploying checkout for a hosted installation. No migrations are added (48 total); existing projects, evidence, triage states, grouping rules, inbound filters, alert rules and project keys are preserved. Keep the existing database, local settings, project keys and deployment receipts; do not reset or restore into the populated installation. Earlier upgrades apply the migrations described in CHANGELOG.md. Archives made by 0.4.0 or earlier restore only into an empty installation; on a hosted installation keep the restore page open until it finishes, because an interrupted hosted restore leaves later restores refused with import_running until the empty installation is removed and redeployed. RER_IMPORT_DOOR is set only by RER for Business-plan installations; self-hosted deploys leave it unset. The application pins rer 0.2.66. SDK 0.2.0 remains unpublished on npm and is not published by this app release.
publicReleaseNotes: Spool 0.5.0 applies inbound filters to every kind of report it accepts, including Sentry feedback and client reports, with counts that match what unmodified Sentry SDKs send. Native JavaScript, Python and Go errors take versioned stack and fingerprint grouping rules with a preview, a per-event explanation and undoable split and merge of selected occurrences. Sentry intake accepts deflate, names and counts unsupported encodings, and keeps valid errors when one item in an envelope is malformed. On installations RER provisions for a Business plan, the Business import door opens at the owner's first claim; self-hosted deploys are unchanged. Upgrading from 0.4.0 adds no migrations and keeps existing data; back up first. The release gate upgraded a populated 0.4.0 install, restored a 0.4.0 archive into a fresh one, ran a real browser app with the published SDK and the Sentry SDK side by side locally and on a fresh Cloudflare deployment, delivered a real new-issue alert email, and restored a hosted backup after removing and redeploying. Known issue: an interrupted hosted restore blocks later restores until the empty installation is redeployed. No Sentry feature parity, Bugsnag or Rollbar support is claimed, and this app release does not publish the SDK. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/spool-issue-page-1600.png
